hypothesis: When a skipped_passage issue [word, last] is confirmed (e.g. e72f9fb1 22:3:9..22:4:9 on a 22:3->22:8 mutashabihat slip), decide() records only its start word in decided. When later speech realigns the jump across a broader overlapping span (22:3:1..22:7:last), decided.has(wi) is false and the checker confirms a second skipped_passage for the same slip. Recording confirmed skipped_passage spans and suppressing any new skipped_passage that overlaps an already-confirmed skip span removes the duplicate skip warning without regressing lab practice or help eval.
